description: Repairs r-wire/create-dao (FDec): the Decimal field was made by CreateField(name, 20) with Precision 38 and Scale 0, every fractional put failed, the stored values were unreadable by DAO and GetRows(100) stopped after 4 of 10 rows; and r-wire/expr-decimal-fields: CDec expressions were refused. Fixture r-fix-wire-ado-fdec-sql-literal: an ACCDB created by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128) and closed, then an ADO connection (Provider ACE) runs CREATE TABLE WD (ID INTEGER primary key, FDecS DECIMAL(18,4), FDecI DECIMAL(28,0)) and closes. DAO reopens read-write and writes each cell (only ID and one column) by INSERT INTO WD (ID, column) VALUES (id, SQL numeric literal) through Database.Execute(dbFailOnError), DBEngine.Errors read right after each. Cells: 1300 FDecS cy-1.5, 1301 FDecS cy-minus-0.0001, 1302 FDecS cy-14.4-digits, 1303 FDecS r8-0.1, 1304 FDecS r8-0.5, 1305 FDecS i4-7, 1310 FDecI bstr-28-digits, 1311 FDecI bstr-29-digits-max, 1312 FDecI bstr-minus-7, 1313 FDecI r8-2.5, 1314 FDecI i4-7. After closing and reopening read-only: TableDef field Type, Size, Attributes and Properties of FDecS and FDecI; a DAO snapshot of each column (field info, every Value once) and GetRows(100) of each; ten expression snapshots, each alone (FDecS + 1, FDecS * 3, FDecS / 3, -FDecS, FDecS + FDecS, FDecI + 1, FDecI * 2, FDecI / 7, Sum(FDecS), Sum(FDecI)), with field info and every Value; then, through ADO, a client static read-only recordset of ID, FDecS and FDecI (field metadata, every Value, GetRows(-1)). Asks the stored values, tags and Decimal words per route, and the errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
